key_insight: MetaSkill-Evolve makes agent self-improvement recursive by evolving not only task skills but also the improvement procedure itself through a two-timescale loop.
engineering_relevance: This suggests a practical route to more adaptable LLM agents that can reuse a single frozen backbone while continuously improving their procedures across changing tasks.
method: Maintain a task skill s that updates quickly from execution traces.
Maintain a branch-local meta-skill m=(ψ,σ,α,π,ε) that configures the Analyzer, Retriever, Allocator, Proposer, and Evolver agents.
Apply the same skill-improvement pipeline to the meta-skill on a slower timescale, with no extra model or objective.
evidence_signal: On OfficeQA, SealQA, and ALFWorld, the method improved held-out test accuracy over the raw backbone by +23.54, +16.09, and +1.92 points, respectively.
watch_item: Recursive self-evolution may increase pipeline complexity and sensitivity to how branch-local meta-skills are updated and stabilized over time.
paper_title: MetaSkill-Evolve: Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agents via Two-Timescale Meta-Skill Evolution
